lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
astrolabe-main: 251 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 251 B.
9 delivered files carry no source map, so their bytes are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.
1,890,212 B in 16 pieces of 11 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
astrolabe-main.mjs at byte 6,513,881, 1,889,955 B, after ../node_modules/pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs: "'(function() {\\n\\t/**\\n\\t* @licstart The following is the en"
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (130 packages, 1,188 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in js and css is left without something that loads it.
